.section{padding:100px 0}.section-titlebar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:35px;gap:26px}.section-titlebar .eyebrow{margin-bottom:12px;display:block}.section-titlebar p{max-width:320px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;font-size:13px}.product-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px}.product-card{position:relative;min-width:0}.product-media{background:#e9e4dd;position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;cursor:pointer}.product-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.product-media:hover img{transform:scale(1.055)}.product-media .tag{position:absolute;left:15px;top:15px;background:#fff;color:#111;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 11px}.wish-btn{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;border:0;width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;color:#171717;background:rgba(255,255,255,.91)}.wish-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:#171717;stroke-width:1.8}.wish-btn.saved svg{fill:#d83b2b;stroke:#d83b2b}.quick-btn{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);color:#161616;border:0;padding:14px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;transform:translateY(130%);transition:transform .2s}.product-media:hover .quick-btn,.quick-btn:focus-visible{transform:translateY(0)}.product-info{padding:17px 0 8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;align-items:start}.product-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:750;margin:0 0 6px}.product-type{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.5px}.price{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.original-price{color:#999;text-decoration:line-through;font-weight:400;margin-right:7px}.stripe-break{height:17px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(130deg,#111 0 24px,#f5f2ed 24px 42px);opacity:.95}
